summary: Iteration 23: Tested new Enquiries Inbox backend (contacts + bookings) and 3 new Arabic RTL pages (/ar/media, /ar/leadership, /ar/faq) plus admin dashboard tabs, status persistence, language toggle mapping, and light-mode hero color. 16/16 backend tests passed. Frontend UI checks all passed with no runtime errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 515 lines; approaching 700-line guideline threshold. Consider splitting auth, uploads, articles, inbox into separate routers if it grows further.
get_contacts/get_bookings ignore unknown `status` query values silently (falls back to no filter). Consider returning 422 for invalid enum to match PATCH behavior.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ contact and 1 TEST_ booking during pytest; both cleaned up via module-scoped teardown that deletes contacts where full_name ~ ^TEST_ and bookings where name ~ ^TEST_. Frontend test flipped an existing real contact to 'contacted' then reverted it to 'new'; toggled the existing booking to 'confirmed' then reverted to 'pending'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login uses HttpOnly cookies (no access_token in JSON body). Use requests.Session() and the cookie will be sent automatically, OR extract session.cookies.get('access_token') for a Bearer header. Both work. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_inbox_iter23.py is reusable for regression. All new data-testids (admin-tabs, admin-tab-articles/contacts/bookings, admin-contact-{id}, admin-booking-{id}, contact-status-{id}, booking-status-{id}, media-center-page-ar, leadership-page-ar, faq-page-ar, ar-leader-card-0..8, ar-leadership-careers-cta, ar-faq-item-*, ar-faq-search, ar-media-search, ar-filter-*, lang-toggle, ar-media-hero, ar-leadership-hero, ar-faq-hero) verified present and functional.

backend_inbox_tests.bookings: POST /api/bookings (public) 200 with reference; GET unauth 401; GET returns newest-first with status 'pending'; PATCH unauth 401; PATCH to 'confirmed' 200; ?status=confirmed filter works; PATCH invalid 422; PATCH unknown id 404. ALL PASS.
